# Build with Jesus

> Build with Jesus pairs the one to eight guide with the Bible and the teachings of Jesus. Young people read, build and serve with an AI agent beside them, and every finished thing goes to their church or their community.

For Christian young people, for adults walking the same road (solo or with friends), and for the churches, religious schools, homeschool families and charities who run it with them.

## Pages
- [Home](https://buildwithjesus.com/): the project overview. Learn. Build. Give.
- [The agent](https://buildwithjesus.com/agent): what it does, what it will not do, and how young people and adults work with it. $29.99 (AUD), one payment.
- [The leaders guide](https://buildwithjesus.com/leaders): the coach for the adults who run the programme, written for church leaders and homeschool families. $29.99 (AUD), one purchase for every leader and every group.
- [Bring the workshop to your church](https://buildwithjesus.com/workshop): In 2027, Brendan O'Keefe plans to travel to run the workshop in person, at one host church for the churches around it. Register your interest; a Southeast Asia itinerary is planned for early 2027.
- [Bring it to your group](https://buildwithjesus.com/groups): two ways to run it with your young people: the in-person workshop, or the leaders guide. For churches, religious schools, homeschool families and charities.
- [Examples](https://buildwithjesus.com/examples): the kinds of builds young people do with the agent: websites, small apps and dashboards for their church, their community and themselves, plus real things made by hand from the guide's activities.
- [How we use AI](https://buildwithjesus.com/ai): our plain statement on AI, including the Ten Commandments for AI Agents. A tool that serves people, scripture quoted exactly and named, local-first privacy, machine-made content labelled, and the teaching, prayer, care and judgement that stay human.
- [Inspiration](https://buildwithjesus.com/inspiration): the Lord's Prayer and eight key Bible passages, quoted exactly and named (King James Version and World English Bible), with spoken audio for each and a short film on praying daily.
- [Legal, terms and privacy](https://buildwithjesus.com/legal): who we are (Brendan O'Keefe, trading as AI Orchestrator, ABN 60 118 175 136), terms of purchase with a 30-day refund and Australian Consumer Law guarantees, privacy for the site and the agent, and plain disclaimers.
- [Safety and data](https://buildwithjesus.com/safety): what stays private, what the site collects, and how the programme runs with leaders in the room.

## Key ideas
- The daily loop: Read (a short Bible passage and one question; the agent helps teach the passage and can help shape a prayer), Learn (a short lesson from the eight essentials, one skill at a time), Build (a small move on a real project), Give (finished things go to the church or community).
- Builds include: the welcome card, the rota, the meal train, the study sheet, the event page, the op shop window.
- For churches, religious schools, homeschool families and charities: a build day, sponsor a builder, and a one page kit.
- The agent is a complete Hermes Agent profile that runs locally on the young person's machine: a morning minute with audio, an afternoon check-in, planning sessions, and the eight essentials curriculum built in.
- The agent costs $29.99 (AUD), one payment.
- The same walk is open to adults: solo or with friends, no group or church required.
- Languages: the homepage is available in Bahasa Melayu (buildwithjesus.com/ms) and Tagalog (buildwithjesus.com/tl); the rest of the site is English for now, with more translations to follow.
- The Ten Commandments for AI Agents govern the agent: the plain form is on the AI page, and the classical and builder's forms ship in its repository.
- Practical setup for the agent: it is software installed on the young person's own laptop. Needs a personal machine with admin access, a one-time $20 OpenRouter credit, optionally a free small local model, and a free Telegram or WhatsApp account for the morning minute and check-ins. No ongoing subscription.
- The leaders guide costs $29.99 (AUD), one purchase for every leader and every group, reused every term.
- The agent is an assistant, never an authority. It points back to the local church and its leaders. Quotes are verified against a named translation.
- The leaders guide is the coach's handbook: it walks church leaders and homeschool families through running the programme with their young people.
- In person, from 2027: Brendan plans to travel to run the workshop at one host church for the churches around it; around $1,000 a day (AUD) plus travel and expenses, agreed up front. Groups share the day; extra days in the same region are $850.
- Built on the one to eight guide: https://www.onetoeight.guide/en/u/
